js_01.m_zh: 温暖的开头；「最疼的」带着宠爱
js_01.d_zh: 画面：你给孩子看一张全家福：帐篷、羊群，十二个儿子排成一排。你的手指停在最小的那个身上。
js_01.m_en: warm storyteller opening; fond on 'loved most of all'
js_01.d_en: Picture: you show a child a family picture: tents, sheep, twelve sons in a row. Your finger stops on the young one.

js_02.m_zh: 慈爱的老爸爸，嗓子有点沙，送礼物特别得意；乐呵呵笑一声
js_02.d_zh: 画面：你把一件亲手做的彩色衣服藏在背后，招手叫孩子过来，然后哗地抖开给他看。
js_02.m_en: an old, loving father, a little husky, proud of his present; a happy chuckle
js_02.d_en: Picture: you hide a coat you made behind your back. You call your boy over, then shake it open in front of him.

js_03.m_zh: 十七岁的阳光男孩，开心坏了，声音里有笑
js_03.d_zh: 画面：你把彩衣套在身上，转了一圈，看着袖子上一道一道的颜色，然后扑过去抱住爸爸。
js_03.m_en: a bright boy of seventeen, thrilled, a laugh in the voice
js_03.d_en: Picture: you put on the coat and spin around. You look at the colour stripes on the sleeves, then run to hug Father.

js_04.m_zh: 自己嘟囔，嫉妒、酸溜溜；真的「哼」一声
js_04.d_zh: 画面：你抱着手站在帐篷边，看着弟弟穿新衣服转圈，低头看看自己身上的旧袍子。
js_04.m_en: muttering to himself, jealous, sour; a real 'Hmph'
js_04.d_en: Picture: you stand by the tent with your arms folded. You watch your brother spin in his new coat, then look down at your old one.

js_05.m_zh: 兴冲冲、天真，完全不知道自己惹人烦；又快又亮
js_05.d_zh: 画面：早上你一醒就冲出帐篷，拉住哥哥的袖子，一边说一边用手比划麦捆怎么弯腰。
js_05.m_en: eager, innocent, no idea he is annoying; quick and bright
js_05.d_en: Picture: you wake up and run out of the tent. You pull your brother's sleeve and show with your hands how the bundles bow.

js_06.m_zh: 气炸了，声音越来越高；「做梦」甩出来
js_06.d_zh: 画面：你正弯腰干活，听完直起身，瞪着这个穿彩衣的小弟弟，手指戳到他鼻子前。
js_06.d_en: Picture: you are bent over your work. You stand up straight, stare at your little brother in his bright coat, and point right at his nose.

js_07.m_zh: 先有点好笑，说到「更生气了」压低、担心
js_07.d_zh: 画面：约瑟头上的梦云里，太阳、月亮和星星一起弯腰。你回头一看，哥哥们的脸越来越黑。
js_07.m_en: a little amused, then lower and worried on 'angrier than ever'
js_07.d_en: Picture: in the dream cloud above Joseph, the sun, moon and stars bow. Then you look back, and the brothers' faces grow darker.

js_08.m_zh: 严肃但温和，不吓人；放慢
js_08.d_zh: 画面：你搂着孩子的肩膀，讲到故事里难过的一段。你说得很慢，让他知道有你在，不用怕。
js_08.m_en: serious but gentle, not scary; slower
js_08.d_en: Picture: your arm is around a child as you reach a sad part of the story. You speak slowly so the child knows you are here and it is safe.

js_09.m_zh: 从井底往上喊，害怕、恳求；很短
js_09.d_zh: 画面：你站在又深又干的井底，仰头只看见一小圈天空，哥哥的头从那圈光里缩回去了。
js_09.m_en: calling up from the well, afraid and begging; short
js_09.d_en: Picture: you stand at the bottom of a deep, dry well. You look up and see only a small circle of sky. Your brother's head moves away from it.

js_10.m_zh: 平平地讲，心里是难过的；「很远很远」拉长、拉远
js_10.d_zh: 画面：骆驼的铃铛叮当响，银子落进哥哥手心。你望着那一队骆驼越走越小，最后变成沙漠里的一个小点。
js_10.m_en: matter-of-fact, sad underneath; long and far on 'far, far away'
js_10.d_en: Picture: camel bells ring and silver falls into the brothers' hands. You watch the camels get smaller and smaller, until they are one dot in the desert.

js_11.m_zh: 老人小声地哭；断断续续，很轻；不嚎
js_11.d_zh: 画面：你坐在帐篷里，把那件空空的彩衣抱在怀里，脸贴在上面。旁边是他睡过的小床。
js_11.m_en: an old man's quiet crying; broken, very soft; no wailing
js_11.d_en: Picture: you sit in the tent and hold the empty coat in your arms. You press your face into it. His little bed is next to you.

js_12.m_zh: 稳稳地讲；「又认真又诚实」为他骄傲；「关进了监牢」叹口气
js_12.d_zh: 画面：你看着约瑟在大太阳下搬罐子，汗流浃背也不偷懒，你点点头。可是下一页，铁门哐地关上了。
js_12.m_en: steady; proud on 'worked hard and was honest'; a sigh on 'put in prison'
js_12.d_en: Picture: you watch Joseph carry heavy jars in the hot sun and never cheat. You nod. But on the next page, an iron door shuts.

js_13.m_zh: 很轻，比以前成熟了；难过但信靠；不自怜
js_13.d_zh: 画面：你坐在冷冷的石头地上，背靠着墙，抬头看小窗口漏进来的一束光，对着那束光说话。
js_13.m_en: quiet, a little older now; sad but trusting; no self-pity
js_13.d_en: Picture: you sit on the cold stone floor with your back on the wall. A line of light comes in from a small window. You speak to that light.

js_14.m_zh: 温暖、笃定，像一只手搭在肩膀上
js_14.d_zh: 画面：那束光正好落在约瑟的肩膀上。你把手轻轻放在孩子肩上，点点头告诉他：是真的。
js_14.m_en: warm and sure, like a hand on the shoulder
js_14.d_en: Picture: the light falls right on Joseph's shoulder. You put your hand on the child's shoulder and nod: yes, it is true.

js_15.m_zh: 神秘又好笑的睡前故事腔；「肥肥的」圆润，「瘦瘦的」细细的；「吃掉了」倒吸一口气
js_15.d_zh: 画面：半夜的王宫里，你打着手电筒给孩子讲怪梦：胖得像皮球的牛，瘦得像竹竿的牛，然后，嘴巴一张！
js_15.m_en: spooky-funny bedtime voice; round on 'fat', thin on 'skinny'; a gasp on 'ate'
js_15.d_en: Picture: night in the palace. You tell a strange dream with a torch under the blanket: cows as round as balls, cows as thin as sticks, and then a big open mouth!

js_16.m_zh: 威风的国王慌了神，好笑；声音又高又乱；最后一句发号施令
js_16.d_zh: 画面：你从大床上猛地坐起来，王冠都歪了，光着脚在宫殿里转圈，朝门口的仆人直拍手。
js_16.m_en: a grand king in a panic, comic; high and flustered; bossy last sentence
js_16.d_en: Picture: you sit up fast in your big bed and your crown is crooked. You walk in circles with no shoes and clap your hands at the servants.

js_17.m_zh: 抱着希望，身子往前探；一夜没睡的国王
js_17.d_zh: 画面：早上，你顶着黑眼圈坐在宝座上，看着刚从牢里带上来的年轻人，身子从宝座上探出去。
js_17.m_en: hopeful, leaning forward; a king who has not slept
js_17.d_en: Picture: it is morning. You sit on your throne with tired eyes. A young man comes up from the prison, and you lean forward to look at him.

js_18.m_zh: 谦卑、平静；「上帝会」说得清楚、有把握
js_18.d_zh: 画面：你在全埃及最大的国王面前鞠了一躬，然后伸出一根手指，轻轻指向天上。
js_18.m_en: humble and calm; clear and sure on 'God can'
js_18.d_en: Picture: you bow to the greatest king in Egypt. Then you lift one finger and point gently up to heaven.

js_19.m_zh: 清清楚楚，像好老师扳着手指数；最后一句着急、热心
js_19.d_zh: 画面：你伸出七根手指数给法老看：先是好年头，再是坏年头。最后你指着满地的麦子，劝他赶快动手。
js_19.m_en: clear, like a kind teacher counting on his fingers; urgent and helpful at the end
js_19.d_en: Picture: you hold up seven fingers for Pharaoh: first the good years, then the bad years. Then you point at the fields of wheat and ask him to act now.

js_20.m_zh: 高兴极了，洪亮、大方；最后一句张开双臂
js_20.d_zh: 画面：你啪啪拍手，从宝座上走下来，把自己脖子上的金项圈摘下来，戴在这个年轻人身上。
js_20.m_en: overjoyed, booming, generous; arms wide on the last sentence
js_20.d_en: Picture: you clap your hands and step down from the throne. You take the gold collar from your own neck and put it on the young man.

js_21.d_zh: 画面：一袋一袋的麦子堆成了小山，仓库的门都快关不上了。你仰着头数，怎么数也数不完。
js_21.m_en: busy and bright; big on 'heaps and heaps'
js_21.d_en: Picture: sacks of grain pile up like little hills, and the barn doors can hardly close. You look up and count, but you can never finish.

js_22.m_zh: 又干又累，说到「只有埃及有粮食」扬起一点希望
js_22.d_zh: 画面：田地变成黄土，锅里空空的。远在家乡的老雅各拄着拐杖，指着埃及的方向，叫儿子们上路。
js_22.m_en: dry and tired, then a lift of hope on 'except in Egypt'
js_22.d_en: Picture: the fields turn to dust and the pots are empty. Far away at home, old Jacob leans on his stick and points toward Egypt. He sends his sons.

js_23.m_zh: 低声下气、很累，从前的神气一点不剩；低着头
js_23.d_zh: 画面：你走了好多天的路，嘴唇干裂。你跪在埃及大官面前，头贴着地，不敢抬眼看他是谁。
js_23.m_en: humble, tired, the old sneer is gone; head down
js_23.d_en: Picture: you walked for many days and your lips are dry. You kneel before the great lord of Egypt with your head on the floor. You do not dare to look up.

js_24.m_zh: 压低声音，和孩子分享一个秘密；「那个梦」带着惊奇
js_24.d_zh: 画面：你捂着嘴悄悄告诉孩子：台上那位大官的心怦怦直跳。眼前哥哥弯腰的样子，和当年梦里的麦捆一模一样。
js_24.m_en: hushed, a secret shared with the child; wonder on 'the dream'
js_24.d_en: Picture: you cover your mouth and whisper to the child. The great lord's heart is beating fast. His brothers bow just like the wheat bundles in his old dream.

js_25.m_zh: 想装成陌生人，可是声音在抖；非常轻
js_25.d_zh: 画面：你戴着埃及头巾，高高站着，努力板着脸。可是一想到老爸爸的白胡子，喉咙就堵住了。
js_25.m_en: trying to sound like a stranger, but the voice shakes; very soft
js_25.d_en: Picture: you stand tall in your Egyptian head-cloth and try to keep a hard face. But you think of your old father's white beard, and your throat goes tight.

js_26.m_zh: 憋不住了：又哭又笑；名字是冲出来的
js_26.d_zh: 画面：你再也装不下去，一把扯下头巾，张开手臂朝哥哥走过去，眼泪哗地流下来。
js_26.m_en: the dam breaks: tears and joy together; the name bursts out
js_26.d_en: Picture: you cannot pretend any more. You pull off the head-cloth and walk to your brothers with open arms. Your tears pour down.

js_27.m_zh: 发抖、羞愧、快哭了；道歉是真心的
js_27.d_zh: 画面：你吓得往后跌坐在地上，眼前闪过那口井和那二十块银子，头再也抬不起来。
js_27.m_en: shaking, ashamed, close to tears; the sorry is real
js_27.d_en: Picture: you fall back onto the floor in fear. You remember the well and the twenty silver coins. You cannot lift your head.

js_28.m_zh: 故事的心：温柔、完全原谅、稳；「把坏事变成了好事」放慢
js_28.d_zh: 画面：你蹲下来，把跌坐在地上的哥哥扶起来，握住他发抖的手，看着他的眼睛，一句一句慢慢说。
js_28.m_en: the heart of the story: gentle, fully forgiving, steady; slow on 'turned it into something good'
js_28.d_en: Picture: you kneel down and help your brother up from the floor. You hold his shaking hands, look in his eyes, and speak slowly.

js_29.d_zh: 画面：你踮着脚往路上张望，看见一长队驴车和家人从远处来了。你跑回来告诉孩子这个好消息。
js_29.m_en: glad, a little out of breath with joy
js_29.d_en: Picture: you stand on tiptoe and look down the road. A long line of carts and family is coming. You run back to tell the child the good news.

js_30.m_zh: 高兴的眼泪，又哭又笑；苍老的声音里全是光
js_30.d_zh: 画面：你拄着拐杖走了好远的路，看见孩子朝你跑来。你扔下拐杖，用两只手捧住他的脸，看了又看。
js_30.m_en: happy tears, laughing and crying together; an old voice full of light
js_30.d_en: Picture: you walked a long way on your stick. Your boy runs to you. You drop the stick, hold his face in both hands, and look and look.

js_31.m_zh: 温暖的道理，直接对孩子说；三个地方轻轻数出来；最后一句带着笑
js_31.d_zh: 画面：全家人朝孩子挥手。你扳着孩子的三根手指数：井、监牢、王宫，然后把他的小手整个包在你的手心里。
js_31.m_en: warm lesson, speaking right to the child; count the three places gently; smile on the last sentence
js_31.d_en: Picture: the whole family waves to the child. You count on three of the child's fingers: well, prison, palace. Then you hold the little hand inside yours.
